summary: A conversation or session that failed to open says why and can be retried

replay.detail: No replay cursor or spool format changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema versions change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: stui keeps the error for a session that could not be opened and asks st again when the person opens it again. The phone no longer says it is trying again after st refused a conversation for good; it shows the reason and retries on tap.

downtime.detail: No coordinated restart or startup work is added.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual action is required.

recovery.detail: No graph recovery or repair is required.
